name: Khalid
story_so_far: I survived a shipwreck and washed up on this island with Noura, Faisal, Salem, and Reem. We have struggled with starvation since Day 3. Noura has been a warrior, foraging despite her injured ankle since Day 2. Faisal and I were partners, but he is now incapacitated with a twisted ankle as of Day 6. I also badly twisted my ankle on Day 4 and remain immobile. We have faced total starvation, notably on Day 4. Salem provides wood and food, while Reem searches the reef. Today, Reem and Noura found one piece of food each, but with two of us injured and food supplies critically low, our survival hangs by a thread. We are all sleeping at Beach Camp, praying for a miracle.

Noura.note: She is incredibly brave for continuing to forage despite her injured ankle.

Faisal.note: He was my reliable partner, but seeing him injured like me makes me fear for our group's strength.

Salem.note: He continues to be a source of hope by providing wood and searching the jungle.

Reem.note: She is working hard at the reef, and her finding food today gave us a tiny bit of strength.

plans: I will try to rest and conserve what little energy I have left, praying that Salem and the others return with enough food to sustain us through the night.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and terrifying. The storm took everything, and now we are just strangers on a beach. I tried to initiate some cooperation, and Faisal seemed to agree with me, which gives me a little hope. We managed to gather some food and wood, but we are still so vulnerable. I'm lying here listening to the waves, praying we see a ship soon.

Today was harder than I expected. Noura is hurt, and seeing her in pain makes me worry about our ability to keep up the pace. The jungle was empty of food where I searched, so Salem and I focused on wood instead. My stomach is still growling, and we only have a little food left. I hope we can find more tomorrow, or things will get desperate quickly.

Today was a quiet, heavy day. Noura managed to find a little food despite her injury, which shows her strength, but it wasn't enough to fill our bellies. Faisal and Reem both came back empty-handed from their searches, and seeing the food stores hit zero makes my heart sink. I feel a deep sense of dread knowing we are eating our last reserves. I hope Salem finds something in the jungle tomorrow, or we are in serious trouble.

I am in pain. I woke up with a twisted ankle that has left me completely immobile, and the weakness from hunger is settling into my bones. Seeing Noura continue to forage despite her own injury breaks my heart, especially since I can do nothing but watch. We ate nothing tonight, and the emptiness in my stomach is terrifying. I pray that Faisal, Reem, and Salem return with something tomorrow, or I fear my body won't hold out much longer.

Today was a heavy day of waiting. Salem brought back a small amount of food, which gave us a tiny bit of hope, but it wasn't enough to feel truly safe. My ankle is throbbing, and the hunger is making my head spin. Watching Noura limp off into the jungle again makes me feel so helpless. I hate that I can't stand up to help them.

Today felt like the beginning of the end. Faisal, my partner in trying to keep us organized, is now down with a twisted ankle just like mine. Seeing two of us unable to move while the others forage is terrifying. We only found two pieces of food between Noura and Salem, which is nowhere near enough for five people. My body is failing me, and the hunger is a constant, dull ache in my chest.

My body feels like it is fading away; every breath is a struggle. We found two pieces of food today thanks to Reem and Noura, but it was barely a morsel for five people. I am lying here, immobile with this throbbing ankle, watching the others push themselves to the limit. I feel a terrible guilt for being useless while they risk everything. If we don't find a significant amount of food tomorrow, I don't know if I can wake up again.
